notes: Captured through the Playwright MCP browser (bot management blocked the bundled crawler). Every page record carries renderedBy playwright, fetchedAt, waitMs, waitMode and httpStatus 200.
adobe.com exposes its Spectrum 2 for Adobe.com token layer as --s2a-* custom properties; those are the normative values below. Milo (EDS) legacy tokens --type-*, --spacing-*, --grid-* also present.
Fonts are proprietary (Adobe Clean, Adobe Clean Display, via Adobe Fonts kit pps7abe on use.typekit.net, bound to adobe.com). Not downloaded.

logo.note: Adobe logo not captured for reuse (trademark).

observedUse.text: #2c2c2c (Milo body, most frequent), #000 and #131313 (s2a headings/body), rgba(0,0,0,.64) subtle text; white and rgba(255,255,255,.64) on dark bands
observedUse.grounds: #ffffff, #f8f8f8 and #f3f3f3 light; #000, #131313, #242424 dark bands (MAX page fully dark)
observedUse.accent: blue-900 #3b63fb fills primary CTAs; blue-1000 #274dea for link/hover text

sources.evidence: --s2a-color-* custom properties on :root; computed colour census

type.licence: proprietary; Adobe Fonts web kit tied to adobe.com. Reuse needs an Adobe Fonts web project licensed for the target domain, or an open substitute (Adobe's own open-source Source Sans 3 is the nearest licence-free relative).
type.observed: Newer s2a sections: display headings 900 with tight negative tracking and line-height = size (56/56 -1.68px, 24/24 -0.96px). Milo sections: headings 800 at 1.25 line height, body 18/27 #2c2c2c.

spacing.grid: 12 columns in a 1200px container (--grid-container-width), margins (100% - 1200px) / 2; 1440px full-bleed frames

motifs.radius: 0 2 4 6 8 12 16 22 24 32 999 (--s2a-border-radius-*); observed: buttons 20px/999px pills, media and editorial cards 16px, merch cards 8px, session cards 12px, content sheet rising over hero with large top radius
motifs.shadows: level-1 0 1px 6px #0000001f; level-2 0 2px 8px #00000029; level-3 0 4px 12px; cards mostly unshadowed
gradients: black scrims over media: linear-gradient(rgba(0,0,0,.9), rgba(0,0,0,.7) 60%, transparent)
warm product gradients (white → #ffa500 family) on Illustrator surfaces
patterns: split hero: copy left, media bleeding off the right edge
bento grid of rounded media cards with captions
autoplaying muted video loops with pause control
sticky light header with outline Sign-in pill

componentStyle.buttonPrimary: blue-900 #3b63fb fill, white 17px/700 text, 2px matching border, 40px tall (button-l), radius 20px (pill), padding 7px 18px 8px; xl: 50px / 19px / radius 25px
componentStyle.buttonSecondary: transparent with 2px #2c2c2c (or black) border, same metrics; hover background rgba(0,0,0,.08)
componentStyle.buttonOnDark: transparent, 2px white border, white text; or white fill with black text
componentStyle.cards: editorial/media cards: no border or shadow, radius 16px, media on top, title 24px/900, body 16-18px; dark overlay cards with white text over imagery; merch cards radius 8px on #eaeaea
componentStyle.links: underlined, black (or #274dea blue in some components), color transition 0.32s cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1)
componentStyle.header: sticky, 72-80px, light grey #f8f8f8/transparent, black 16px/700 nav, active item underlined, outline 'Sign in' pill

motion.reveal: entry reveal driven by view() timelines (animation-timeline: view(40% 10%), range entry): elements start translateY(24px) and opacity 0, settle to 0; staggered for groups (enable-parallax-stagger)
signature: split hero pin-and-pan on scroll (sh-fix / sh-pan / sh-lock, named timeline --split-hero, exit-crossing ranges)
garage-door section reveal with background parallax (MAX)
bento stack: cards scale down with depth mask as the next slides over
motion.media: hero and feature media are autoplaying, muted, looping videos with a visible pause button

voice.tone: confident, short declarative headlines with full stops ('There's only one Photoshop.'), sentence case, eyebrow labels above H2s
